cases.invariant: In Storybook the favorites realtime hook subscribes only the signed-in user's channel and removes it on unmount, without a live client
cases.actor: Signed-in fixture user user-939 in a Story
cases.input: renderHook with userId user-939, then unmount
cases.response: one channel('favorites:user:user-939') with filter user_id=eq.user-939; removeChannel called once on unmount; no error thrown
forbiddenEffects: the channel left subscribed after unmount
cases.testName: Storybook Supabase client stub (Task 939) [SEC-939-FE-STUB-ALLOW] useFavoritesRealtime mounts on the stub, subscribes only the user's favorites channel and removes it on unmount

cases.invariant: The Storybook client stub never reaches the network
cases.actor: Any Story that reaches the browser client
cases.input: the realtime hook mounted, a favorites table query, an auth session read
cases.response: the query resolves data null and error null; the session is null; WebSocket and fetch spies record zero calls
cases.testName: Storybook Supabase client stub (Task 939) [SEC-939-FE-STUB-DENY] the stub opens no WebSocket and sends no fetch for the realtime channel, a table query or an auth read

cases.invariant: The real browser client fails closed without its public configuration, so a Story must never reach it
cases.actor: A Storybook build without Supabase configuration
cases.input: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY stubbed to empty strings
cases.response: createClient throws the @supabase/ssr URL and API key error
forbiddenEffects: a client created with an empty URL or key
cases.testName: Storybook Supabase client stub (Task 939) [SEC-939-FE-CLIENT-ERROR] the real browser client refuses to start without NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY

cases.invariant: A signed-in user adds and removes only their own favorite row
cases.actor: Signed-in user user-939 (getUser double), not blocked
cases.response: insert of { user_id: user-939, listing_id: listing-939 }; delete filtered by user_id user-939 and listing_id listing-939; favorites revalidated for every locale; isFavorited true then false
forbiddenEffects: a user_id taken from the input
a delete without the user_id filter
cases.testName: favoriteActions (Task 939) [SEC-939-SRV-FAV-ALLOW] a signed-in user adds and removes only their own favorite row

cases.invariant: An anonymous caller cannot change favorites
cases.testName: favoriteActions (Task 939) [SEC-939-SRV-FAV-DENY] an anonymous caller is refused before any database client is created

cases.invariant: A blocked user cannot change favorites
cases.actor: Signed-in user user-939 whose getBlockedError returns a block error
cases.testName: favoriteActions (Task 939) [SEC-939-SRV-FAV-BLOCKED-DENY] a blocked user is refused with the block error and nothing is written

cases.invariant: A failed favorite write is reported as an error and revalidates nothing
cases.input: the insert resolves an error with code 42501
cases.response: a result with an error field and no isFavorited; console.error called once
forbiddenEffects: isFavorited true after a failed write
a revalidation after a failed write
cases.testName: favoriteActions (Task 939) [SEC-939-SRV-FAV-ERROR] a failed insert returns an error, logs once and revalidates nothing
